9:/-! ## Project-local Mathlib supplement — D1: the presheaf pullback Lan decomposition
10:
11:These are general `PresheafOfModules` statements (any `F : C ⥤ D`, ring presheaves
12:`R, S`), not specific to schemes; they are project-local because Mathlib's pinned commit
13:exposes neither `extendScalars` nor `pullback₀` at the presheaf-of-modules level. Both are
14:realised as the left adjoint of an existing right adjoint: `pushforward₀ F R` is
15:definitionally `pushforward (𝟙 (F.op ⋙ R))` (because `restrictScalars (𝟙) = 𝟭` on the nose,
16:witnessed by Mathlib's `restrictScalars (𝟙 R)).Full := inferInstanceAs (𝟭 _).Full`), and
17:`restrictScalars φ` is definitionally `pushforward (F := 𝟭) φ`; since `pushforward _` is
18:always a right adjoint, so are these two, and their left adjoints `pullback₀`/`extendScalars`
19:exist. The decomposition `pullback φ ≅ extendScalars φ ⋙ pullback₀` then follows from the
20:definitional factorisation `pushforward φ = pushforward₀ F R ⋙ restrictScalars φ` by
21:uniqueness of left adjoints (`Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso`).
22:
23:Per blueprint `lem:pullback_lan_decomposition` (D1). **OFF-PATH (iter-243 pivot).** D1 is
24:axiom-clean and self-contained, but it was the first brick of the ABANDONED general
25:strong-monoidal pullback build (`sec:tensorobj_pullback_monoidality`, route (e)); the active
26:route is the loc-triv chart-chase D1'–D4' (§below), which does NOT consume `extendScalars`/

28:toward the general build (D2 scalar-strong / D3 topological-interchange are NOT pursued). -/

30:section PullbackLanDecomposition
31:
32:variable {C : Type u} [Category.{u} C] {D : Type u} [Category.{u} D]
33:  {F : C ⥤ D} {R : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{u}} {S : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{u}}
34:
35:/-- `pushforward₀ F R` is a right adjoint: it is definitionally `pushforward (𝟙 (F.op ⋙ R))`
36:(since `restrictScalars (𝟙) = 𝟭` on the nose). Project-local; carries the existence of the
37:topological inverse image `pullback₀`. -/
38:private lemma pushforward₀IsRightAdjoint (F : C ⥤ D) (R : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{u}) :
39:    (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀.{u} F R).IsRightAdjoint :=
40:  inferInstanceAs (PresheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} (𝟙 (F.op ⋙ R))).IsRightAdjoint
41:
42:/-- `restrictScalars φ` is a right adjoint: it is definitionally `pushforward (F := 𝟭) φ`.
43:Project-local; carries the existence of the extension of scalars `extendScalars`. -/
44:private lemma restrictScalarsIsRightAdjoint (φ : S ⟶ F.op ⋙ R) :
45:    (PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} φ).IsRightAdjoint :=
46:  inferInstanceAs
47:    (PresheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} (F := 𝟭 C) (R := F.op ⋙ R) φ).IsRightAdjoint
48:
49:/-- **The topological inverse image `pullback₀ := (pushforward₀ F R).leftAdjoint`**, the
50:left adjoint of the fixed-ring pushforward. On underlying presheaves it is the left Kan
51:extension along `F.op`. Project-local (no `PresheafOfModules` inverse-image functor at the
52:pin); the carrier of D3. -/
53:noncomputable def pullback0 (F : C ⥤ D) (R : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{u}) :
54:    _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} (F.op ⋙ R) ⥤ _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R :=
55:  haveI := pushforward₀IsRightAdjoint F R
56:  (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀ F R).leftAdjoint
57:
58:/-- **Extension of scalars `extendScalars φ := (restrictScalars φ).leftAdjoint`**, the left
59:adjoint of restriction of scalars along a morphism of ring presheaves. Project-local; the
60:carrier of D2 (strong monoidal via `distribBaseChange`). -/
61:noncomputable def extendScalars (φ : S ⟶ F.op ⋙ R) :
62:    _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} S ⥤ _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} (F.op ⋙ R) :=
63:  haveI := restrictScalarsIsRightAdjoint φ
64:  (PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars φ).leftAdjoint
65:
66:/-- The adjunction `pullback₀ ⊣ pushforward₀`. -/
67:noncomputable def pullback0Adjunction (F : C ⥤ D) (R : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{u}) :
68:    pullback0 F R ⊣ PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀ F R :=
69:  haveI := pushforward₀IsRightAdjoint F R
70:  Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀ F R)
71:
72:/-- The adjunction `extendScalars φ ⊣ restrictScalars φ`. -/
73:noncomputable def extendScalarsAdjunction (φ : S ⟶ F.op ⋙ R) :
74:    extendScalars φ ⊣ PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars φ :=
75:  haveI := restrictScalarsIsRightAdjoint φ
76:  Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars φ)
77:
78:/-- **D1 — the presheaf pullback Lan decomposition** (blueprint `lem:pullback_lan_decomposition`).
79:For `φ : S ⟶ F.op ⋙ R` presenting a pushforward of presheaves of modules, the presheaf
80:pullback factors as extension of scalars followed by the topological inverse image,
81:`pullback φ ≅ extendScalars φ ⋙ pullback₀`. This is the left-adjoint reversal of the
82:definitional factorisation `pushforward φ = pushforward₀ F R ⋙ restrictScalars φ`, obtained
83:from `Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso` (uniqueness of left adjoints). Project-local. -/
84:noncomputable def pullbackLanDecomposition (φ : S ⟶ F.op ⋙ R) :
85:    PresheafOfModules.pullback φ ≅ extendScalars φ ⋙ pullback0 F R :=
86:  (Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso
87:    (extendScalarsAdjunction φ) (pullback0Adjunction F R)
88:    (PresheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction φ)
89:    (Iso.refl (PresheafOfModules.pushforward φ))).symm
90:
91:end PullbackLanDecomposition

2:/-- A morphism of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y` is flat if for each affine `U ⊆ Y` and
3:`V ⊆ f ⁻¹' U`, the induced map `Γ(Y, U) ⟶ Γ(X, V)` is flat. This is equivalent to
4:asking that all stalk maps are flat (see `AlgebraicGeometry.Flat.iff_flat_stalkMap`).
5:-/
6:@[mk_iff]
7:class Flat (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop where
8:  flat_appLE (f) :
9:    ∀ {U : Y.Opens} (_ : IsAffineOpen U) {V : X.Opens} (_ : IsAffineOpen V) (e : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U),
10:      (f.appLE U V e).hom.Flat
11:
12:alias Scheme.Hom.flat_appLE := Flat.flat_appLE
